sources.description: Standalone full painted rectangle. Tight frontal head-and-shoulders portrait with a small margin over the head and shoulders cut by the side and lower canvas edges. Broad bald/receding crown with very short gray side hair, dark furrowed eyebrows, and a dense short salt-and-pepper full beard covering both cheeks, jaw and chin and connecting to the moustache. Serious expression, lips very slightly parted, eyes looking almost toward the viewer. No hat or eyewear. Dark navy/near-black civilian jacket with broad notched lapels, a pale gray-white pointed shirt collar and a burgundy necktie; no visible medals or added insignia. Preserve the original soft pale gray-green painted backdrop across the entire rectangle, brighter above and darker toward the shoulders, with light mainly from screen-left and deeper shade on screen-right. There is no card frame, note, caption or external cutout. Original measured alpha230..255, with no zero-alpha pixels; preserve the complete painted canvas and its backdrop rather than cutting out the figure.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Tight chest-up portrait, nearly frontal with a slight head turn toward screen-right and eyes near the viewer. Short close-cropped dark curly hair with slightly receding temples, dark brows, smooth upper lip and chin, and neutral slightly parted lips. No beard, moustache, eyewear or hat; do not interpret the skin and mouth shadows as facial hair. Olive-brown/khaki military jacket with broad notched lapels, shoulder straps bearing small round gold buttons, and small crossed gold linear emblems on both lapels. Pale white-gray pointed shirt collar and a dark nearly black necktie. No chest medals are visible. Preserve the exact differing shoulder/face angle, the narrow headroom, the lower chest crop and the soft light from above/screen-left. Full pale gray-green painted background reaches every canvas edge, with no photo card frame, note or caption. Original alpha is255 throughout. The crossed shapes are visible, but their tiny internal emblem detail is not readable; preserve only the visible crossed gold marks without inventing a precise named insignia.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Tight chest-up portrait with torso angled toward screen-left and head turned slightly in the same direction while the eyes look nearly at the viewer. Short close-cropped dark wavy/curly hair, a high/receding hairline, dark arched eyebrows, neutral closed lips and a visibly smooth upper lip and chin. The dark lip edge and small shadow below the mouth are shading, not a separate moustache or chin beard; keep the face smooth. No hat or eyewear. Ochre-olive military jacket with broad notched lapels, shoulder straps with small gold buttons and crossed gold linear emblems on both lapels; pale gray-white pointed shirt collar and a dark tie with subtle lighter diagonal bands. Preserve this three-quarter shoulder position and the original lapel folds and overlap. Small headroom, shoulders/chest cropped by the side and lower edges, soft stronger screen-left light and a muted pale gray-green painted background filling the whole rectangle. No card frame, note, caption or exterior cutout; measured alpha255 throughout. Tiny internal insignia details are not readable beyond the visible crossed gold shapes, so do not invent a specific insignia design.
